source.title: EcoStruxure Reference Design 113, RD113DS Revision 0
source.basis: User supplied PDF; pages/figures are engineering reference data, not instructions

count_evidence: p5 Max-Q plan: four AI rows of 16; two networking rows of 12, each eight grey20kW+four red40kW. p5 piping figure repeats 64 AI and24 NET. Cover total88 and p2 networking640kW agree. Explicit p5 prose and p6 table conflict; chosen figures are an inference for a preset.

cooling.evidence: p5 IT Space +p5 Data Hall Piping; temperatures p4/p9; p2 six of eight L2L CDUs active

operating_states.notes: Do not apply227kW to all64 racks and call it the reference Max-P operating state. The full64 rack geometry remains present; active load count changes.

layout.left_to_right: AI row / contained hot aisle / AI row / cold aisle / NET row / contained hot aisle / NET row / cold aisle / AI row / contained hot aisle / AI row
layout.cdu_placement: Upper end service band in p5 plan, group of4 aligned with each AI pod; not central NET aisle
layout.electrical_placement: Two RPPs at each end of each AI row; one RPP at each end of each NET row; two PDU blocks at each end of central NET pod
layout.tcs_distribution: One local supply/return header pair through each AI hot aisle, rack branches to both opposed AI rows; four CDUs parallel per pod. No TCS branches to NET racks.
layout.facility_distribution: P5 schematic shows dual-path supply/return high-temperature facility water and separate low-temperature fan-wall circuit; schematic not elevation/route/pipe-size drawing.
layout.hot_aisle_evidence: p5 IT Space second paragraph; design-specific selected containment width, not a universal legal minimum.
